# QuantyCoin (QTY) - Large Language Model (LLM) Index

> QuantyCoin is a decentralized, high-throughput Layer-1 proof-of-work (PoW) blockchain engineered with pure zero-mock cryptography (Secp256k1, Ed25519, BIP39/44), an atomic UTXO state machine, LWMA-1 difficulty adjustment, Stratum mining pool support, and standalone Cyberpunk darkmode desktop GUIs.

## Core System Overview & Architecture
- [Repository](https://github.com/timfromhcs/QuantyCoin): Official source repository on GitHub.
- [Executive README](https://github.com/timfromhcs/QuantyCoin/blob/main/README.md): System architecture, tokenomics, and installation guides.
- [Public Genesis Metadata](https://github.com/timfromhcs/QuantyCoin/blob/main/public_genesis.json): Genesis block parameters, timestamp, and consensus rules.
- [Full LLM Context](https://github.com/timfromhcs/QuantyCoin/blob/main/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive multi-file documentation for AI agents and code generators.

## Key Tokenomics & Consensus Specifications
- **Ticker**: QTY
- **Total Maximum Supply**: 21,000,000 QTY (2,100,000,000,000,000 Satoshis)
- **Block Target Time**: 60 seconds (1 minute)
- **Initial Block Reward**: 50.00 QTY
- **Halving Interval**: Every 2,100,000 blocks (~4 years)
- **Difficulty Adjustment**: Linear-Weighted Moving Average (LWMA-1) computed per block
- **Max Block Size**: 32 MB (33,554,432 bytes)
- **Transaction Fee Distribution**: 50% Miner / 50% Community Treasury
- **Address Format**: Native SegWit Bech32 (`qty1q...`) and Base58Check
- **Network Ports**: P2P: 19888, JSON-RPC/REST: 19889, Stratum Pool: 3333, Web GUI: 8080-8083
- **Wire Magic Bytes**: `0x51 0x55 0x41 0x4E` ("QUAN")

## Package Structure
- `core/`: Transaction models (BIP141 SegWit), Block & Header, UTXO state machine with BlockUndo journal, Mempool, Consensus & Halving.
- `crypto/`: Pure Secp256k1 elliptic curve arithmetic, RFC 6979 nonce generation, BIP39 24-word mnemonics, BIP44 HD key paths (`m/44'/999'/0'/0/0`), Ed25519 signatures, Keccak-256, double-SHA256, RIPEMD-160.
- `network/`: P2P TCP wire framing, peer connection lifecycle, protocol message serializers (`version`, `verack`, `inv`, `getdata`, `block`, `tx`), broadcast router.
- `node/`: Full Node Daemon (`quantyd`), Chainstate manager, fork-choice rule, multi-block reorganization engine, JSON-RPC 2.0 & REST HTTP server on port 19889.
- `wallet/`: BIP39 HD Wallet (`quanty-wallet`), coin selection algorithms, transaction signing, ASCII & PNG QR code generation, remote RPC failover client.
- `miner/`: Multi-threaded parallel CPU/GPU mining engine (`quanty-miner`), block template poller, live hashrate telemetry, Stratum V1/V2 server (port 3333).
- `ui/`: Standalone and Combined Cyberpunk Dark Mode GUIs (`#0A0D14`, `#00F0FF`, `#8A2BE2`, `#1E2433`) for Node, Wallet, Miner, and All-in-One Suite.
- `tests/`: Multi-Node Stress Testsuite (Mempool Saturation 500+ TXs, Deep Reorg Recovery, Double Spend Rejection, P2P Chaos Engine), Docker testnet matrix.
- `packaging/`: Windows NSIS & InnoSetup installers, Linux .deb & AppImage, macOS Universal .dmg, GitHub Actions release pipeline.

## Primary CLI Commands
```bash
# Start Full Node
python quantyd_cli.py --port 19888 --rpcport 19889

# Create BIP39 HD Wallet
python quanty_wallet_cli.py create

# Query Address Balance
python quanty_wallet_cli.py balance --address <qty1q...>

# Start Solo Miner
python quanty_miner_cli.py --address <qty1q...> --threads 4

# Launch All-in-One Cyberpunk Desktop GUI
python quanty_suite_app.py
```
